POPUCOM is available now on PS5! 

Summoned to an unknown planet, you and your friends must embark on a vibrant exoplanet adventure to restore the world to its former glory. Master color-changing mechanics, solve intricate cooperative puzzles, and use unique gadgets to blast through quirky enemies and tricky obstacles.

Key Features:
• Engage in Fun-Filled Cooperative Gameplay – Team up in local couch co-op or online multiplayer for the two player campaign, or up to four for party mode. Effective communication and teamwork are the way forward!
• Embark on a Colorful Adventure – Color is the key to everything from puzzle-solving to combat. Switch colors on the fly to trigger mechanisms and clear paths.
• Customize Your Adventurer – Express yourself with a variety of outfits and accessories before setting off on your journey.
